text: William Styron's Sophie's Choice was banned in Lebanon for its positive depiction of Jews. In 2002 the Norwalk-La Mirada High School District pulled it from the La Mirada High School Library in California because of a parent's complaint about its sexual content.
meta_description: William Styron's Sophie's Choice was banned in Lebanon and pulled from the La Mirada High School Library in California in 2002.
